title: Ship-gate Account-only changelog hubs
summary: Shipping no longer offers sibling website changelog or hub updates; Change Log Hub work stays on this MyAPES Account app only.
changes: Remove the post-merge ship-gate option that asked to update sibling website changelogs and hubs.
Document that post-merge changelog and Change Log Hub checks cover this repository only.
affected_areas: Release and Change Log Hub process docs
version_rationale: Patch release: clarifies shipping scope for changelog hubs without changing runtime product behaviour.
validation: Confirmed agent docs no longer list the sibling website changelog gate option.
php artisan myapes:changelog-validate --base-ref=origin/main on the PR branch.
known_limitations: None. Runtime Change Log Hub behaviour is unchanged; this release updates agent shipping guidance only.
rollback: Redeploy the previous application version and restore the prior ship-gate docs if the Account-only hub policy must be reversed.
provenance: Ship-gate Account-only changelog hubs chore for issue #196, pull request #197.
